claim: The declared measured fast-rotator surface route preserves min_materials better than the declared actively hosted sunward route, conditional on a measured rotation period at or below 30 minutes.

limitations: Target scarcity and survey value are not monetized.
Irregular geometry and illuminated-state heat rejection remain outside the matched ledger.
Screening allocations are not spacecraft design values.
provenance.fact_summary: Accepted PRs #35-#37 establish, repair, and externalize the matched comparison without changing its result.
provenance.inference_summary: Fast rotation should be treated as a conditional mission-selection constraint before paying for active hosting.
provenance.speculation_summary: A target-selection strategy may outperform host-assisted geometry for some survey missions if sufficiently valuable fast rotators are common enough.
